Provide original documents.3) Provide scans for TECHNICOL V-ST 3mm Protective membrane with lots 80882, 81177 and document numbers 2731, 5548 respectively for actual delivery. Provide original documents.4) The document for the Fastening element Fastener TECHNONICOL No. 01 with lot 10 was not provided.5) Scan document for LOGICBASE V-strip FB 1,3 mm TECHNONICOL tape with lot 62002 and number 9014 was provided. There is no document for the delivered products with lot 61923. Provide original documents.6) Scans of documents for Technonikol 500 g/m2 nonwoven geotextile material with lots 302400, 302531. To provide original documents.7) Scans of documents for Technonikol 600 ml swelling sealant with lot *563. Provide original documents.8) Scans of documents for TECHNICOL IC-SP swellable polymer profile from batch 96/23, actual delivery from batch 98/23. Documents for the actual delivery were not provided. Provide original documents.9) In English translations of documents for Extrusion polystyrene foam XPS Carbon PROF 1180x580x100 mm TECHNONICOL the batch size is not specified. Provide original documents.Staff the document scans appropriately.
